calculation.description: At the decision date, assign a higher score to assets whose most recently completed session declined from open to close; this is a contrarian intraday reversal signal.
calculation.timing: Use only the completed prior session OHLC; forward return begins after the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year 2020-2026 (year means 0.0299, 0.0577, 0.0569, 0.0452, 0.0604, 0.0544, 0.0378). The 1-day horizon passes benchmark gates; predictive power decays at 5-10 days. Small cross-asset universe uncertainty is mitigated by 1,685 dates and average 14.54 valid instruments.
